title: Driver Incentive Terms: Personal Offers, Targets and Bonus Payment
content:
## Terms in force

**T1. Offers are personal.** Under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, each incentive offer record carries its own market, window, target and reward, and only trips that satisfy the incentive counting basis count toward it: completed trips driven by the driver whose drop-off falls inside the offer's window (from its start, inclusive, to its end, exclusive), in the offer's market; for a referral offer, the trips of the referred driver instead.

**T2. Consecutive-trip offers.** A consecutive-trip offer pays when its target number of qualifying trips are completed in a row, each next trip accepted within 15 minutes of the previous drop-off.

**T3. Referral offers.** A referral offer pays when the referred driver completes the target number of trips within 30 days of their activation (the offer window).

**T4. Opt-in.** An offer whose incentive type requires opt-in (the earnings guarantee) pays only if the driver opted in before its window start; the opt-in is the driver's own action. The opt-in record on the driver's offers, and the moment it was made, are the evidence.

**T5. Payment.** Earned bonuses post within 3 calendar days after the window end, once per offer: an offer that already has a bonus entry on the earnings statement is not paid again.

**T6. Claim window.** A driver may raise an unpaid bonus only within the claim window: The claim window is counted in calendar days from the offer's window end date: day 1 is the calendar day after the window end, and the question must be raised no later than the last day of the window. The claim window is 14 calendar days.

**T7.** Near misses are never paid, and offers are never extended or combined.

## Retired terms

**R1.** The former term under which a quest paid its stated reward amount once when the qualifying trips reached the target trip count is no longer in force; the crediting of an earned quest is governed by the current quest reward basis of the product.

**R2.** The former term under which an earnings guarantee paid the guaranteed amount on the offer less the window earnings (counting only the earnings that count toward a guarantee), when positive, provided the driver was online at least the required online minutes, kept an acceptance rate of at least the guarantee's minimum and a cancellation rate of at most the guarantee's maximum over the window, is no longer in force; the payment of an earnings guarantee is governed by the current guarantee opt-in basis of the product.

## The claim window on both sides

| Day the unpaid bonus is raised, counted from the window end date | Within the claim window? |
|---|---|
| Day 1: the calendar day after the window end date | Yes |
| Day 14: the last day of the window | Yes |
| Day 15 or later | No |

**Hypothetical dated case.** An offer whose window ends on 10 May: day 1 is 11 May and day 14 is 24 May. An unpaid bonus raised on 24 May is within the claim window; one raised on 25 May is not.

## Points of judgement

| Question | Answer under the terms in force |
|---|---|
| A hypothetical consecutive-trip offer of 6 trips: the fourth trip is accepted 22 minutes after the third drop-off | The run is broken at that gap; the trips before it do not continue into the trips after it |
| A referred driver reaches the trip target on day 31 after activation | Not paid (the target must be met within 30 days) |
| An earnings guarantee whose opt-in was recorded after the window started | Not paid |
| A target missed by one trip | Not paid: near misses are never paid |
| A bonus entry for the offer is already on the earnings statement | Not paid again: once per offer |

superseded_clauses: A quest pays reward_amount once when the qualifying trips reach target_trip_count

An earnings guarantee pays the guaranteed_amount less the window earnings (earnings_msr_guarantee_window_earnings, counting only guarantee_earnings_basis), when positive, provided the driver was online at least required_online_minutes, kept an acceptance rate of at least guarantee_min_acceptance_rate_pct and a cancellation rate of at most guarantee_max_cancellation_rate_pct over the window.
